cost: THE SUBJECT LANDS 94 AGAINST A STATED 93 +-2, AND 93 EXACTLY COSTS A FITTED CONSTANT. There is no fitted number in this round: par is 1.0, the certification is recal_114's own VOTE_SUPPORT_POW, and the refund share is the file's own height_inv. At full strength the subject reads perdef 68 / DEF 94, one point above his number and inside his tolerance. Every partial strength was measured on the full pipeline: a rate of 0.70 on the refund lands him DEF 92, 0.85 lands 93-94, 1.00 lands 94. A later ruling that wants 93 EXACTLY is asking for a fitted rate on a term that otherwise has none, and it is one constant to add.

notes: THE SUBJECT, DECOMPOSED BEFORE ANYTHING WAS TOUCHED. Mark Eaton '85 — Defensive Player of the Year, All-Defensive 1st team, 5.6 blocks a game (the NBA record), BLK% 8.7 at the 99th percentile of 1985, DBPM +4.2 at the 99th — read perdef 57 and DEF 89. The big vector: 0.40 x perdef 57 + 0.40 x rimprot 98 + 0.17 x drb 89 + 0.03 x discipline 55 = 78.85, x 1.1305 = 89.14. Every bar but one is where a DPOY's should be; the whole gap to his number is perdef.

WHERE THE 57 COMES FROM, AND IT IS ONE BAND READ TWICE. The PD composite is drep 0.453 + dbpm 0.238 + height_inv 0.309. At 88 inches height_inv = max(0, 1-(ht-80)/8) pays 0.000, and recal_54's rep_hf = max(0.5, 1.2-0.8*clip((ht-80)/6)) sits on its 0.5 floor, so his ballot term pays 0.453 x 1.00 x 0.50 = 0.227 where a wing collects 0.544 for the SAME ballot. The two height terms are 0.76 of the composite's weight (0.309 + 0.453) and they are read off the same 80-inch band. His composite is 0.4632 — the 4th percentile of the 1985 voted pool, 26th of 27, above Kareem alone. That pool is sorted almost exactly by height and the season's DPOY is at the bottom of it.

recal_101 ALREADY NAMED THIS DEFECT IN THIS FILE, IN THESE WORDS: 'a composite that charges his height twice (rep_hf halves his votes above 6'8" AND height_inv zeroes at 7'4")'. What that round did about it was not to repair the composite but to let a full tracked sample FLOOR a voted card — which is why Victor Wembanyama '26, the same 88 inches with the same two zeroed terms, prints perdef 74 off -8.6% over 765 shots. Before 2014 there is no such channel, and this file's own header says what is left: 'All-D/DPOY votes are the ONLY recorded measure of pre-tracking perimeter D'. In the untracked era the height split halves the only measure there is and nothing can answer it. That is the class, and `season < 2014` is recal_146/183's own sentinel for it.

WHY THE REFUND IS CERTIFIED BY DBPM AND NOT BY SOMETHING NEW. The REASON rep_hf discounts a big's ballot is that a big's All-Defensive votes may be RIM votes, and rimprot pays those already. This file built a meter for exactly that question and gated it on DBPM support — recal_114's VOTE_SUPPORT_POW, 'votes rimprot has already cashed are backed in perdef only by a top-decile DBPM'. rep_hf is the SAME deduction taken a second time and it is gated on nothing but height. So the refund is paid at the share that meter already certifies. The subject certifies at 0.982; Moses Malone '85 (DBPM -1.4) and Kevin McHale '85 (-0.2) certify at nothing and are byte-identical in the subject's own season.

WHY THE REFUND IS SIZED BY 1 - height_inv, AND WHY THAT MAKES THE ROUND CONSTANT-FREE. The defect is that ONE height is charged TWICE, so the refund is the size of the charge already made — the card term's own spent share, written from the same expression the PD line reads. 0.000 at 6'8", 0.375 at 6'11" (Duncan '03, Camby '07), 0.625 at 7'1" (Shaq '00, Robinson), 0.750 at 7'2" (Mutombo), 1.000 at 7'4" and up (the subject, Bol, Yao). And PAR is 1.0, not recal_54's 1.2: recal_97's note records that 1.2 is a WING PREMIUM, the thing that takes a perfect perimeter sheet over unity (0.453 x 1.2 + 0.238 + 0.309 = 1.0896). Par makes the class self-defining — rep_hf is at or above 1.0 through 81.5 inches — so every card 6'9" and under is untouched BY ARITHMETIC: Rodman '89/'90, Roundfield '80/'82/'83, Buck Williams '91, Pippen, Jordan '89, Malone '97, Ben Wallace '03/'04/'06, Bobby Jones '82, Ginobili '11, Klay '13, Joe Dumars '90.

MEASURED ON THE WHOLE POOL BEFORE APPLYING. 109 of 10,000 cards move perdef and EVERY ONE OF THEM UP (largest +16); 82 move DEF, none down, largest +5; 54 move OVR, none down, largest +2; ZERO move OFF and zero move any other attribute. The perdef top 12 and the DEF top 12 are unchanged, name for name and in order. All 193 anchors hold, 0 failing, mean |error| 0.84 — the same mean the round started from.

THE CLASS IS FOUND BY THE TERM AND READS LIKE IT. David Robinson '90-'96, Mark Eaton '84-'90, Dikembe Mutombo '96-'99, Tree Rollins '82-'84, Hakeem Olajuwon '93-'95, Manute Bol '86, Alonzo Mourning '99, Marcus Camby '07 — voted centres in the era before anyone measured what a man gave up on the perimeter, every one of them with a DBPM his season agreed with.
